posts.title: The Night Shift
posts.description: Or, How I Taught a Robot to Do My Chores While I Sleep Lately I’ve been waking up to work I don’t remember doing. I haven’t taken up sleepwalking to my desk — something else has been up working while I slept. For the past few months I’ve been running a small AI agent that clocks in around midnight.
